creator: Alexander Terp
description: An interactive dash holding a HUP trap does not run it while a foreground loop runs, so a closed pane's process outlives the close until the loop next reads the dead tty. The daemon could follow SIGHUP with SIGKILL to the process group after a grace period. Found while running the suites under dash (./dev --linux).
title: Close a pane whose shell defers SIGHUP
